notes.title: Would you like to see DISTRAINT 3?
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys! [/p][p][/p][p]DISTRAINT is turning ten years old in a few months. Time surely flies by! 😅[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10370616/a826885ae69df21b099e3cb73c34fa6596ab4b8e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I haven't yet decided what to do next. I've heard people asking for DISTRAINT 3, and quite frankly, it doesn't sound like a horrible idea. My latest releases haven't been selling well enough, so my next game needs to be something that will do well. That said, the timing could be right for DISTRAINT 3 if there's demand from the players.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the players started a petition to gauge the interest. That said, if you would like to see DISTRAINT 3 happen, you could sign the petition and share it with like-minded people: [url="https://www.petitions.com/we_the_players_want_distraint_3"]https://www.petitions.com/we_the_players_want_distraint_3[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If this gets enough attention, I'll create DISTRAINT 3. 😎[/p][p][/p][p]EDIT: After reading some of the comments, I'd like to add that I would not continue Mr. Price's story unless I come up with a really good one! DISTRAINT 3 could also be a new story with mostly new characters. Some people are concerned that I'm doing this for the wrong reasons, but let me assure you that's not the case. Whatever I do next is something I want to do, and it has always been that way. ☺️[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers and thanks for all the support![/p][p]Jesse[/p]

notes.title: DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey folks![/h2]

[h2]STEAMWORKS.MFX[/h2]

It has been a while since the latest update. I've heard from some folks that they were having problems launching the game. I hope this update fixes the missing steamworks.mfx error!

[h2]STEAM DECK[/h2]

While updating, I made the necessary changes for that sweet Steam Deck Verified badge. I will submit DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition and DISTRAINT 2 for the verification. I've completed both DISTRAINT games with my Steam Deck without any problems, so I believe it is only a matter of time before both games are officially verified.

[h2]FONT[/h2]

Likely, the most significant change I made is updating the font to the fantastic Silver font by Poppy Works. This font supports all languages, although it might miss a word or two in Chinese/Korean/Japanese.
If you have any problems with the font/subtitles or with the game, please let me know via email: makkonen.j.k@gmail.com


[h2]LEGACY EDITION[/h2]

Due to outdated code and compatibility, I removed "DISTRAINT Legacy Edition" from the default branch.

I've created a new "legacy" branch that includes the old build. You can access this build by right-clicking DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition on Steam -> Properties... -> Betas -> Beta Participation and selecting "legacy" from the drop-down menu.

Note that this is an old build that I'm no longer updating.

[h2]POSSIBLE WINDOWS SCALING BUG[/h2]

While testing, I noticed Windows scaling setting affected font rendering. If you're having a hard time reading the subtitles, please try setting your Windows "Scale" to 100%. You can find this setting from "Display settings" -> "Scale".

Thank you, and happy gaming! :)

Jesse

notes.title: DISTRAINT 2 Releasing 13th of November
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

First, I'd like to thank you for all the support and patience. It has helped me to create this game, thanks! :)

I've finally decided release-date for DISTRAINT 2. Like the title says, 13th of November, exciting!

Now the next part is essential, so please read carefully. Many games are releasing daily, and the competition is fierce. To make it with DISTRAINT 2 and keep developing in the future, I'd appreciate if you could add DISTRAINT 2 to your [u][b]wishlist.[/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/743390/DISTRAINT_2/

That's important and an excellent way for me (and perhaps even for Valve?) to check how many people are interested in the game, so please, consider adding to your [u][b]wishlist.[/b][/u] I can't stress this enough.

Okay, how about translations?

Currently, I'm writing the last dialogues in English. I plan to get all the dialogue done within the next two or three weeks, and after that get the game translated into as many languages as possible before the release. I'm still not sure how to approach this, there are already many volunteers, so I might go with them. But like I said, I'll think about how to approach this once I've dialogues ready. That said, I'll try to include as many translations in the release as possible.

Thank you for your support! :)

Jesse

Quite a few people asked if I was going to release "Deluxe Edition" for mobile devices as well. At first, I told them "no", but more and more people asked... Also, DISTRAINT 2 is coming soon. Unfortunately not this May as I first planned, but very likely next August. It will be worth the wait, I promise!

notes.title: DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition releasing 29th of September
notes.notes:
Good day!

I'm excited to tell you that DISTRAINT will receive a free "Deluxe Edition" update on Steam 29th of September!
DISTRAINT has been doing pretty good, so I thought the players deserved a little bonus!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10370616/83423919354045182193012659d1384ca2a0002c.png[/img]

Before I tell what's new, please read as this is important!

DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition will replace DISTRAINT on Steam.
That means if you want to complete "the original" DISTRAINT before updating to Deluxe Edition, please turn off auto update for DISTRAINT on Steam.

The good news is that I've done my best to make the transition as smooth as possible; game save file is compatible. 
Also, your settings are safe and carried over to Deluxe Edition.

The biggest difference in gameplay is that the Deluxe Edition has no lantern.
I felt it didn't add much to the game and by removing it, I could increase environmental lighting. It was most definitely worth it. Trust me! :)

Alright, what's new you may ask:

* Dynamic coloring - Goodbye gray, hello color!
* No more lantern - Increased environmental lighting
* Enhanced animation, graphics, and lighting effects
* Refined audio for better atmosphere
* Improved user interface

I've also added Turkish (Thanks to farukturk55) and Polish (Thanks to Ikskoks) translations!

[h1]EDIT: I've created a launcher that lets you choose if you want to play DISTRAINT or DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition, this means the "original DISTRAINT" will remain playable! :)[/h1]

Cheers, and thank you for reading,

Jesse
